title: Data Analytics Engineer I
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

You will be joining the Financial Infrastructure team, responsible for building and maintaining the core systems powering our internal financial ecosystem. Every year, we process hundreds of billions of events that have a financial impact on Checkout.com and our merchants. Our team is responsible for maintaining an accurate record of all financial data, the data integrity of our systems and ensuring our infrastructure meets regulatory and compliance obligations in a scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant manner.

 

As an Analytics Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in our mission to make our financial data capabilities world-class. You will work closely with our Finance and Treasury teams to translate their requirements into robust and intuitive data models. You will design and build the data pipelines necessary to process and transform large amounts of data that our systems generate. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of these data pipelines, as Checkout continues to scale as a business. You will have ownership over these processes, allowing you to take charge in maintaining a high standard of data quality.

 

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Design and build data pipelines to process data from our systems, services and applications.

  • Implement monitoring and alerting frameworks to ensure data pipeline performance and reliability.

  • Partner with other analytics engineers to design and implement scalable data models that support downstream business operations and analytical queries.

  • Ensure data governance and security standards are maintained across our systems.

  • Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies to improve our platform and systems.

  • Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and Service Level Agreements.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineering or Data Engineering role with a focus on large scale data transformation and data warehousing.

  • Excellent SQL coding skills.

  • Experience with cloud-based data warehouse technologies such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or AWS Redshift.

  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, or Dataflow.

  • Understanding of data modeling techniques.

  • Experience with using visualisation platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Apache Superset.

  • Understanding of software engineering best practices and their application to data processing systems.

  • Knowledge of Python, Java or Flink is a plus, but not a necessity.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Data Analytics Intern
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Data Analytics Intern and help build the technical foundation that protects our 700,000+ customers. You'll join the Risk Analytics team, working closely with Vatsal Parekh to deliver reliable data, reporting and tools that help Risk & Compliance teams respond to regulators, auditors and internal controllers — while exploring how AI can make that work smarter.

Internship, ideal start January 2027
Planned duration: 6 months

➡️ In this internship, you will:
  • Handle real stakeholder requests: Deliver reliable SQL data extracts for regulatory reporting, audits and internal controls, owning daily "run" tickets with increasing autonomy.
  • Build and improve dashboards: Analyse data and create or enhance reporting dashboards and visualisations that Risk & Compliance teams actually use to steer activity and risk.
  • Maintain and develop technical tools: Apply and grow your SQL and/or Python skills to maintain and improve existing tools and code — you don't need to master both from day one.
  • Grow into a bigger project: Depending on your capabilities and team priorities, you may contribute to or take ownership of a longer-term technical project over the internship — scope to be confirmed with your manager.

➡️ What you can expect:
  • Visible impact: Your data and tools directly support how Risk & Compliance teams respond to regulators, internal auditors and controllers.
  • Close mentoring: You'll be mentored by Vatsal Parekh and Omayma Nayma, with weekly 1:1 check-ins and day-to-day support.
  • Room to grow: Your scope can expand as you demonstrate capability — there's no fixed ceiling on what you can take on beyond the daily tickets.
  • Modern, AI-native stack: Unlimited access to AI tools like Claude Code to accelerate your work.
  • Hybrid work in Paris: 2 days remote per week


➡️ About You:
  • Technical foundation: You're ideally an M2 / final-year student (gap-year candidates welcome) in Computer Science, Software or Computer Engineering, from an engineering school or a technically strong university programme — international universities welcome, provided your school can issue a convention de stage.
  • Practical skills: Python and/or SQL fluency. You write clean maintainable code and know how to structure a real project.
  • Communication: You are fluent in English and can clearly communicate your work with teammates and stakeholders.
  • Experience: A previous relevant data or engineering internship is a plus; so is experience with dashboards or maintaining existing tools.
  • Curiosity: You're interested in fintech and banking and willing to learn the compliance context. A dual technical/finance background is a bonus, not a must.
➡️ About your future Manager:

Your manager will be Vatsal Parekh, Lead Risk & Compliance Engineering at Qonto. He'll give you day-to-day context on how Risk Analytics supports regulators, auditors and internal controllers, while giving you room to build practical experience and take on more responsibility as you go.
  • His background? Vatsal spent close to a decade at Société Générale as Senior Regulatory Risk Manager and Global Product Owner for the Counterparty Credit Risk platform, leading a team across the Americas, Europe and Asia with direct exposure to ECB and Fed regulatory frameworks. He then moved into risk and compliance consulting at Tremau, managing a team of 10 delivering engagements for global e-commerce and social media platforms, before joining Qonto in 2026.
  • What he brings to the team? A combination of hands-on regulatory risk expertise, consulting-grade delivery rigor, and deep technical fluency — 10+ years of SQL, hands-on use of AI-assisted workflows, and a track record of building data and reporting processes from scratch. He gives the team both technical grounding and a first-hand read on what regulators and auditors actually need.


At Qonto we understand that true diversity isn't just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick! Who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we've been searching for all along.

Perks

Flex your schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.

Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.

Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.

Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.

Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.

Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
description:
Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

Omega Enterprises is an international digital-assets company focused on cryptocurrency markets, market intelligence, and data-based financial operations. We are expanding our team and looking for motivated people who would like to build practical knowledge of digital markets and develop their analytical skills.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates who are interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, and working with market information. Previous employment in the crypto industry is not necessary. New team members receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support from experienced colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Follow daily developments across cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.
  • Assist the team with routine operational and analytical activities.
  • Track changes in prices, trading activity, liquidity, and other relevant indicators.
  • Gather information from internal and external market-data sources.
  • Maintain organized records and prepare concise internal reports.
  • Summarize market observations for team discussions.
  • Take part in regular training, feedback sessions, and team meetings.
  • Complete structured tasks under the guidance of more experienced team members.

What You'll Get

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Flexible day-to-day workflow.
  • Structured onboarding for people new to the crypto industry.
  • Training in basic market-analysis and digital-asset tools.
  • Access to practical market information and analytical resources.
  • Regular feedback and guidance from a mentor.
  • A clear path for developing toward more advanced analytical responsibilities.
  • Opportunity to work within an international digital-assets team.

The Person We're Looking For

  • Are genuinely interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, or market analytics.
  • Enjoy learning new tools and working with structured information.
  • Pay attention to detail when handling data and written tasks.
  • Can follow procedures and instructions consistently.
  • Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently.
  • Have English proficiency around B2 or higher, sufficient for professional tools, market information, and training materials.

Position Details

  • Position: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
  • Work format: Remote
  • Experience: Entry level / training provided
